label: PF Backlog 682
title: Dev-Ex & CI: Fast-tier PR gate with 1-hr scheduled full sweep and atomic item finalization
body:
Optimization to reduce backlog item cycle time from 39 min to ~16 min without cutting quality corners.

1. Replace precheck --full with fast-tier precheck in PR CI merge gate.
2. Add 1-hour scheduled GitHub Actions workflow running precheck --full on develop.
3. Diff-scope design-pack in fast tier to active/changed design file.
4. Provide --auto-bundle in scripts/dev/finalize_item.py for 1-shot completion.
5. Document Go-by-default execution and single-pass spec/design authoring.

acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Pull request CI workflow executes precheck in fast tier (diff-scoped) instead of precheck --full.
AC-2: Scheduled GitHub Actions workflow runs precheck --full on develop branch every 1 hour with workflow_dispatch support.
AC-3: Scripts/dev/design_pack.py in fast tier evaluates only the active or changed design file rather than full historical archive.
AC-4: Scripts/dev/finalize_item.py provides --auto-bundle flag to atomically package delivery states, ac_verification, final report, and trail stages.
AC-5: Workflow and developer contract documents updated with Go-by-default execution rule and single-pass spec and design authoring pattern.
